propositions: BindingStore's 799-line module conflates byte persistence, lifecycle policy, and recovery logic with no cohesive ownership of new safety rules, creating regression risk across crash behavior, index lag, identity mapping, and selective publication
Production code mutates inner binding entries returned by shallow all_bindings() query, violating encapsulation and safety constraints

Durable tombstone retirement intent must be authoritative: a live forward/reverse pair is removed only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities agree, and only explicit unretire revokes that intent
Interrupted retirements must be completed by exact-match local state before remote issue observation to prevent interleaving new liveness evidence with completion

New architectural decomposition extracts repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, and recovery behind a public facade while preserving all serialization, unknown-field, JSON formatting, and compatibility behaviors
